payload.name: Preserve Distinct Events on Update
payload.description: When a new message describes an event or fact that differs from an existing memory (different date, milestone, or topic), before applying an UPDATE verify whether the existing memory is truly the same fact; otherwise ADD a separate memory.
content: During the CRUD/update stage, before applying UPDATE to an existing memory, check whether the new message describes the same event/fact as the existing memory (same subject, same event type, and same time period).
If the new message describes a distinct event, even with the same people, do not overwrite the existing memory; create a new ADD candidate for the new event.
Preserve the original memory's content, world_start, and facts unless the new message explicitly corrects or supersedes that same fact.

When two related but different events exist (e.g., a pregnancy announcement and a later marriage announcement), keep them as separate memories and only update one when the new evidence directly revises that same memory.

solves: Prevents a later message about a different event from overwriting an earlier distinct memory during construction updates. When a new message involves the same people but describes a separate milestone, date, or topic, the agent should ADD a new memory instead of UPDATE-ing the old one, preserving previously stored facts.
